notes.title: Old Evil Can Learn New Tricks
notes.content:
Greetings Killers,

What a month it’s been. This will be our final patch before the Beta ends on September 6, just before we launch on September 8! Scary! But we have such sights left to show you... with one last big update for you to play before release! The game has taken its final evolutionary turn, and you'll find a whole new level of challenge as evil has grown stronger.  

Here’s what all is new: 

[list]
[*] Almost every monster and boss in the game has had their sprites touched up or improved.
[*] All bosses have new moves and behavior and should, across the board, be much more interesting as well as uniquely challenging. We also made sure Tier 1 and Tier 2 versions of the same boss have extra variance between them. You thought two Wendigos were bad? Wait till you meet their Tier 2 version.
[*] One entirely new boss joins the carnage! The [b]Straw Man/Wicker Man[/b] will keep you on pins and needles... and flaming nails! He’s a ranged boss that prefers to stay away from you, and will make you dance with crazy AOEs. 
[*] You’ll find Tier 3 a bit more manageable. The ranged attacking Hunter has gone off to new lands in search of prey but you’ll find the Trapper is prowling around living up to his name. We suggest taking him out at a distance… And remember, you can disarm bear traps.
[*] We’ve tweaked some items for better functionality, namely Charon Coin, Bear Traps, and the Raven Feather. You’ll now see their maximum range as a radius. 
[*] We’ve also looked at some balance issues, namely changing a few items that were over performing against bosses. We’ve completely changed Blood Rage as part of this. You no longer paste enemies in one strike, you do 1 damage as you have nothing but your fists, but you now restore ALL Actions each time you get a kill. Keep killing and you’ll keep on going! Fleshbound Text also does only 1 damage to bosses instead of wiping them out, and the Ad Extremum Terrae now only stuns bosses for 1 full turn. 
[*] You’ll see a new title screen when you load up the game.
[*] Steam Cloud saves are also here.
[/list]

While this is the last beta update, we’ve got a few major additions that will be implemented in full release that you won’t get to see before we go live: 2 more new bosses, a whole new introduction/mini-tutorial and ending, unfortunate humans wandering the nightmare, and a manual for more in-depth info (built into the game, but will also be a PDF in the game files). 

Thanks for playing Living the Nightmare Beta, everyone! We do hope you’ve enjoyed your time in our Nightmare. We’ve certainly appreciated your feedback, it really helped hone the game extensively. We feel pretty ready for launch now. 

Speaking of which, we hope you’ll rejoin us in Nightmare when we go live September 8! There will be a 10% discount for the first week. 

Happy Entrails!

notes.title: A Monster of an Update
notes.content:
Greetings Killers,

 A lot has happened in the Nightmare! Here's a rundown on whats in the latest, massive patch.

Firstly, you may notice we have [b]new sprites for the Faceless[/b] that goes a bit further down the horror path. We hope you find him a lot more creepy and monstrous, as he should be. 

We figured you could use some new toys, too, so [b]we tripled the amount of weapons in the game[/b]. There are now 30 melee weapons and 6 ranged weapons, up from 9 and 3 respectively! This is in addition to the 9 new Masks we introduced recently to the game as well (up from 5), so there should be a whole lotta new ways to fight the hordes. 

There’s even a whole [b]new class of melee weapons: Spears![/b] Do some stabbing at a safe distance, and even skewer multiple targets that have conveniently lined up! 

You’ll also find some new tricks among the old standbys. Many can now cause critical hits or stun targets, and some can knock monsters to adjacent tiles, so you’ll have a much bigger toolkit. 

All but three of these new weapons have Lore/Quotes, too. 

We have also changed a few systems. 

[b]We implemented the most requested addition to the game: END TURN![/b] Just mouse over the Faceless’s hex and a prompt will appear. Click in that Hex and it’ll give you a confirm message… one more click and you will end your turn. Make sure you do everything you want to do before you use this, since once you click to confirm, no matter how many Actions you have, it will advance to the monsters’ turn. 

We’ve also changed and tightened Action Swapping. It’s now remapped to mouse wheel. When you mouse over a hex, the available actions for that hex will orbit the cursor, as before, but now you can switch through them by turning the wheel. 

We’ve also changed Examining by dropping the click+hold mechanic. It’s now much faster. Just mouse over an enemy or object and right click to Examine them and see their stats. To close the info box, right click again, or just mouse away and it will close automatically. Now you can get monster stats on the fly. 

We also added an option on the title screen and in the pause menu to resize the system cursors. There’s three sizes available you can cycle through.

You can now also switch the game to run in windowed or full screen with an option on the title screen and in the pause menu. 

A few enemies have had some adjustments. The Royal Troglodyte is now tougher and should be a better fight, and Maw Worms have gotten an extra Heart. Purple Worms have an extra Heart and an extra Damage. Don't be underestimating them now!

Navigation Points for the biomes have also been given a generic icon that denotes a Point of Interest so you have to go check it out to see which biome it actually is. Chests within these biomes now have their own Nav icons, and Arcane Shrines (the ones with random effects) also have a specific icon so you can tell more clearly what’s around you. 

That’s all for this round. Lots more still coming, too, but we hope this will keep you busy for a while. 

Until next time… 

Happy Entrails!

notes.title: New Patch for August 8
notes.content:
Greetings killers,

Welcome to those who are new to the Nightmare. We have such sights to show you!

The highlights of this update are the new UI elements that we hope will give you a greater sense of your progress during a run. Namely, a kill tracker, a shrine/boss tracker, and a tier indicator. To go along with this clarity, we also added some alerts that will draw your attention to important things you are triggering (or accomplishing). Like when a boss is coming for you. ːHappyEsheː

One note with these features: they have tooltips, but are not yet included in the tutorial directly. 

We also cleaned up the engine a bit. You will notice shrines spawning in nearer to your current position, as well as (hopefully) a snappier response for your input when moving and fighting. 

We also introduced a [i]fatal[/i] error in the tutorial, but it should now be splattered. ːOgreNukeː Apologies for those that were quick on the trigger to try things out only to be stopped [i]dead[/i].

[b]As an Update to the Update [/b]we also added 7 new masks to game, and some audio feedback when selecting tiles. 

Till next time, happy entrails!
